plan_corrections_to_task_description: Do NOT extend ModalPotentialInv (FmpMeasure.lean:2326): its rankBound/rankEdge fields are exactly what transitive box propagation breaks. Build a sibling S4LoopInv in LoopChecking.lean instead; FmpMeasure.lean stays untouched.

Do NOT prove 4-rule soundness via Satisfies.four (Basic.lean:348): it is stated in diamond form (<><>phi -> <>phi); the 4-rule is box-side and the box dual does not exist in Basic.lean. Prove directly from IsTrans.trans, mirroring the T arm's use of hrefl.refl.
